unlisted_practices: Dual-loop agent architecture with cross-session memory and adaptive therapy strategy selection for longitudinal counseling
Emotion-aware dynamic response strategy selection in LLM counseling agents

screen.reason: The paper introduces TheraMind, a novel dual-loop agent architecture for longitudinal psychological counseling, and evaluates it in a simulated environment based on clinical cases. It develops and benchmarks a new agent system rather than evaluating an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
